title: CoreBunch/Instatic
claim: CoreBunch/Instatic — The open-source alternative to Webflow, Framer and WordPress. Agentic self-hosted visual CMS outputting clean static pag
why_good: An agent-driven, self-hosted visual CMS that outputs clean static sites — a credible open take on Webflow/Framer for the self-host + AI crowd.
value: Hosted tier + templates + agency licenses for people who want Webflow-style building without lock-in or per-seat SaaS fees.
risk: Webflow/Framer are deeply entrenched with huge ecosystems; 'agentic + self-hosted' must be dramatically easier to pull switchers.
pick_reason: It offers a clear product that can be monetized through hosting services or premium features.

zh.claim: CoreBunch/Instatic —— Webflow / Framer / WordPress 的开源替代:agent 驱动、自托管的可视化 CMS,输出干净的静态页。
zh.why_good: agent 驱动、自托管、输出干净静态站的可视化 CMS——面向"自托管 + AI"人群,一个可信的 Webflow/Framer 开源替代。
zh.value: 托管版 + 模板 + 代理商授权,卖给"想要 Webflow 式搭建、又不愿被锁定或按席位付费"的人。
zh.risk: Webflow/Framer 根基深、生态大;"agent + 自托管"必须明显更省事才能撬走用户。
zh.hook: 一个 agent 搭建、可自托管的 Webflow——输出干净静态站的可视化 CMS。

hook: An agent-built, self-hosted Webflow — a visual CMS that outputs clean static sites.
